editorNotes: Added from your pop-culture notes: KATSEYE, PinkPantheress, and original fangirl references. Main quiz and Ask share a theme, with distinct Ask answers. Reference URLs need source review before approval.

daily.question: One Direction’s “Kiss You” music video includes which matching costume scene?
daily.explanation: The playful Kiss You video includes a striped jailhouse scene among its staged settings.

daily.question: 5SOS’s “She Looks So Perfect” name-checks which underwear brand?
daily.explanation: American Apparel is the brand named in the song’s well-known reference.

daily.question: Which Jonas brother played Shane Gray in Camp Rock?
daily.explanation: Joe Jonas played Shane Gray; Nick and Kevin also appeared in Camp Rock.

daily.question: Demi Lovato’s Camp Rock character was named…
daily.explanation: Demi Lovato played Mitchie Torres in Camp Rock.

daily.question: Taylor Swift’s original 2012 album with “I Knew You Were Trouble” is…
daily.explanation: I Knew You Were Trouble appears on the original 2012 release of Red.

daily.question: Justin Bieber’s 2011 concert film is titled…
daily.explanation: Never Say Never was Bieber’s 2011 concert film; Believe followed in 2013.

daily.question: On Big Time Rush, the aspiring band’s manager was…
daily.explanation: Gustavo Rocque, played by Stephen Kramer Glickman, manages the fictional band.

daily.question: The Vamps’ 2013 debut single was…
daily.explanation: Can We Dance was released as The Vamps’ debut single in 2013.

daily.question: Paramore’s “Misery Business” first appeared on which album?
daily.explanation: Misery Business appears on Paramore’s 2007 album Riot!.

daily.question: Miley Stewart’s pop-star alter ego in the Disney series was…
daily.explanation: Miley Stewart lived a double life as Hannah Montana in the original Disney series.

tumblr.question: David Tennant first played which numbered Doctor?
tumblr.explanation: Tennant’s first Doctor incarnation was the Tenth.

tumblr.question: Dan and Phil’s 2015 book was titled…
options: The Amazing Book Is Not on Fire
tumblr.explanation: The Amazing Book Is Not on Fire combines references to their old channel names.

tumblr.question: Who played Merlin in the BBC series Merlin?
tumblr.explanation: Colin Morgan played Merlin; Bradley James played Arthur.

tumblr.question: Which fanfiction platform is associated with an orange W logo?
tumblr.explanation: Wattpad’s branding is associated with an orange W.

tumblr.question: Which album includes One Direction’s “Night Changes”?
tumblr.explanation: Night Changes is a track on Four, released in 2014.

youtube.question: Which creator is associated with the Vlog Squad?
youtube.explanation: David Dobrik’s videos were associated with the Vlog Squad creator group.

youtube.question: Which creator made the viral “Power of Makeup” video in 2015?
youtube.explanation: NikkieTutorials’s Power of Makeup video became a major 2015 beauty reference.

youtube.question: Which duo’s shared channel is called KianAndJc?
youtube.explanation: Kian Lawley and JC Caylen post together as KianAndJc.

youtube.question: YouTube Rewind was an annual…
youtube.explanation: YouTube Rewind recapped parts of the platform’s culture and trends.

youtube.question: Our2ndLife is often abbreviated…
youtube.explanation: O2L was the shorthand for the collaborative channel Our2ndLife.

modern.question: “Aged like milk” says a take has…
modern.explanation: It is a negative judgment about how something held up over time.

modern.question: Violating Community Guidelines was hosted by Brittany Broski and…
modern.explanation: Brittany Broski and Sarah Schauer hosted the podcast.

modern.question: A fancam originally focuses on…
options: A performer filmed by a fan
modern.explanation: Fan-shot performance videos helped popularize fancams, particularly in K-pop.

modern.question: Trixie and Katya’s Netflix reaction series is called…
modern.explanation: I Like to Watch features Trixie Mattel and Katya reacting to Netflix programming.

modern.question: Holo Taco is a brand founded by…
modern.explanation: Cristine Rotenberg, of Simply Nailogical, founded Holo Taco.

ask.answer: The Adventurous Adventures of One Direction
clues: A fan-made animation, rather than an official band film.
Its creator supplied the cartoon and the voices.
The original installment appeared on YouTube in 2012.
It turns the members of One Direction into cartoon adventurers.
Its title is The Adventurous Adventures of One Direction.
ask.explanation: Mark Parsons created the fan-made 2012 animation The Adventurous Adventures of One Direction.
